note: Declares the private placeholder keys this repo TEMPLATES, WITHOUT their values. The values live in ~/.ai-tooling/values.json, outside the working tree. Descriptions here must not reveal the value they describe. The build uses this list to recognise a placeholder as legitimate even on a machine (or a CI runner) that has no values file. This is not the same set as the values file: a value may live there purely as a leak detector, with no placeholder anywhere, and should not be listed here. See docs/security.md.

values.MSK_CLUSTER_NAME: Name of the Kafka/MSK cluster referenced by example queries in the checking-kafka-offset-lag skill.
values.MSK_EXAMPLE_CONSUMER_GROUP: Consumer group used as the worked example in the checking-kafka-offset-lag skill. Discloses internal service and pipeline naming.
values.WORK_MARKETPLACE_REPO: Repository name of the employer's internal Claude plugin marketplace, referenced in the settings backup.
